analysis:
Units 5 and 6 are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 772-1264), which is documentation only. The patch excerpt shows the head change as a v0.10.5 candidate header, upgrade/rollout notes and a new sandbox bullet, but it is truncated at a partial sandbox-add-on line. No executable code, config, or workflow in the supplied evidence changed, so I identified no concrete security regression.

Security-relevant claims in the base text that the threat model already covers: encrypted SSD prefix-cache defaults and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch (T-041); GLM-5.3-Flash debug cache key file, said to be DEBUG-only and absent from release builds; uncached weight hashing (T-012/T-027); the staging and dev-branch release lanes with a relaxed installer signature check for -dev./-staging. versions (T-013/T-034/T-061); and the fan helper (TB-010). All of these are base-side changelog statements about earlier releases, not changes in this PR.

Remaining integration questions for later passes: (1) the new head text about `darkbloom sandbox` running the add-on installer from api-sandbox.darkbloom.dev (TB-013/T-061) is truncated here, so verify that the actual code and the threat model cover it; (2) the MLX pin bump changes the metallib hash, so confirm the provider qualification and attestation contracts (T-054) still bind the correct hashes; (3) confirm the relaxed installer signature check for pre-release versions is limited to pre-release version strings in scripts/install.sh. I did not see those source files, so no conclusion is possible on them. Docs-only evidence is not proof that the code is safe.
